title: SIPLab Shared Finding
description: Mandatory 10-key envelope that every protocol skill emits. Skills may add skill-specific keys after the shared ones; they may not omit any shared key. See boot/boot.md Block 2 for the prose contract.

skill.description: Catalogue number and short name, e.g. '01-registration'.

test_id.description: The test_id of the analyzed test case.

summary.description: One sentence: what the skill concluded.

verdict.description: Whether the SIP procedure under test completed successfully (pass), did not complete (fail), or cannot be decided from the evidence table (insufficient_evidence).

failure_stage.description: Where observed behavior departs from expected behavior. 'none' exactly when verdict is 'pass'.

evidence.description: Observations only, copied from the test message. A frame item cites the evidence table; a stream item cites the RTP STREAMS block. Every item must exist in its source (checked by tools/validate_evidence.py).

stream.description: SSRC of the RTP stream, as printed in the RTP STREAMS block.

field.description: Column heading of the RTP STREAMS block, e.g. 'Lost'.

next_check.description: One suggested manual check, or null. Never an automatic action.

rationale.description: Why the verdict was reached: observations, expected behavior, and any suspected cause explicitly labeled as suspected.

placeholder.description: Optional. true only in the fixed reply of an unimplemented placeholder skill. The orchestrator treats such findings as skipped.
